assessment.summary: This study investigated pyrethroid resistance in Anopheles coluzzii populations from three sites in southern Benin (two agricultural, one urban). It integrated WHO bioassays, kdr-West genotyping, biochemical enzyme assays, and RT-qPCR gene expression analysis. Results showed widespread resistance and high kdr-West allele frequencies across all sites, with evidence of multifactorial resistance involving metabolic detoxification mechanisms.
